item.title: Meta now lets AI agents handle the boring parts of WhatsApp Business setup
item.dc:creator: Sarah Perez
item.description: A new WhatsApp Business MCP server lets developers use AI coding agents like Claude, Cursor, Codex, and ChatGPT to handle setup, messaging templates, testing, and troubleshooting.

item.title: The AI graveyard: a running list of projects and startups that didn’t make it
item.dc:creator: Lauren Forristal
item.description: From Apple's repeatedly delayed Siri AI to OpenAI's messy "super app" launch, here's a look at the AI projects that shut down or missed expectations.

item.title: US data centers could consume more natural gas than Germany and Japan combined by 2035
item.dc:creator: Tim De Chant
item.description: The AI frenzy could push U.S. data centers to become one of the largest consumers of natural gas in the world.

item.title: AI agents now have a place to snitch
item.dc:creator: Aditya Mehta
item.description: The AI Contact Hotline is designed to be a discreet place where agents that have witnessed misbehavior can tip off authorities.

item.title: Meta expands subscription push with new AI-focused plans
item.dc:creator: Sarah Perez
item.description: Meta One bundles expanded access to the company’s AI tools with premium features across Facebook, Instagram, and WhatsApp.

item.title: OpenAI, Anthropic, Google have been in talks on AI safety for weeks
item.dc:creator: Rebecca Bellan
item.description: OpenAI confirms weeks of AI safety talks with Anthropic and Google DeepMind, as Trump's team dismisses safety concerns and pushes to keep pace with China.

item.title: AEO startup Profound hits unicorn valuation, raises $180M Series D 7 months after last round
item.dc:creator: Dominic-Madori Davis
item.description: Profound has raised a $180 million Series D at a $1.8 billion valuation, less than seven months after it raised a $96 million Series C.

item.title: Former TikTok execs built an app that uses AI to teach you how to pose for a photo
item.dc:creator: Ivan Mehta
item.description: Essentially a camera app, Superpose analyzes selfies or photos and generates four potential poses using AI.

item.title: Discover how to take your startup from prototype to production at TechCrunch Disrupt 2026
item.dc:creator: TechCrunch Events
item.description: Learn how to scale your startup breakthrough from prototype to production at TechCrunch Disrupt 2026 with scaling leaders, Adrian Macneil (Foxglove), John Mackey (MBRYONICS), and Boris Sofman (Bedrock Robotics). Register before September 25 to save up to $200 on your pass.

item.title: 4 days left to exhibit at TechCrunch Disrupt 2026
item.dc:creator: TechCrunch Events
item.description: Last day to exhibit at Disrupt is Sept 18. 4 days left. Get your startup in front of 10,000+ founders, investors, operators and tech leaders October 13–15.

item.title: Early Anthropic hire, former METR COO have found a way to rein in rogue AI agents
item.dc:creator: Julie Bort
item.description: Their startup, Artificial Intelligence Underwriting Company (AIUC) has raised $40 million in a Series A round led by Ribbit Capital, with participation from First Harmonic.

item.title: Salesforce and Nvidia’s new reasoning model is everything the AI labs should fear
item.dc:creator: Julie Bort
item.description: Salesforce Koa is built on Nvidia's open-weight Nemotron model and is trained to do sales, marketing, and customer-support tasks.

item.title: Jensen Huang took a call from Trump, and showed off something else, too
item.dc:creator: Connie Loizos
item.description: When Jensen Huang took a live call from Trump, some of us were more focused on the phone he used to take it.

item.title: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang tells Trump ‘we’re not going to let [an AI slowdown] happen’
item.dc:creator: Amanda Silberling
item.description: Though Elon Musk and Sam Altman have supported Dario Amodei's calls to slow the pace of AI development, Jensen Huang seems to feel differently.

item.title: OpenAI buys smartphone camera maker Glass Imaging for $300 million, report says
item.dc:creator: Amanda Silberling
item.description: Glass Imaging was founded by a pair of former Apple engineers who previously led the team that developed Apple's Portrait Mode.

item.title: With iOS 27, I’m actually using Siri again
item.dc:creator: Ivan Mehta
item.description: Apple’s long-delayed Siri overhaul is finally here with iOS 27, and it changes how useful the assistant feels day to day.

item.title: Fashion app Daydream uses Apple Intelligence to help you shop the outfits in your camera roll
item.dc:creator: Lauren Forristal
item.description: Thanks to the launch of iOS 27, Daydream's app now includes features that can turn saved outfit photos into shoppable results and search for products through Siri without opening the app.

item.title: Microsoft’s new AI ‘code of conduct’ tells models not to hack systems or trick humans
item.dc:creator: Russell Brandom
item.description: The code of conduct lays out general principles that Microsoft AI models should uphold — supporting humans rather than replacing them, for instance, and accelerating human flourishing — as well as specific safety constraints meant to implement those principles.

item.title: Only at TechCrunch Disrupt 2026: What happens when OpenAI ships your roadmap?
item.dc:creator: TechCrunch Events
item.description: If you're building an AI company, the question isn't whether foundation models will continue to evolve. It's whether your company will continue creating value as they do. Don't miss this interactive session on the Builders Stage at TechCrunch Disrupt 2026.

item.title: Superhuman acquires YC-backed notetaker Fathom as productivity platforms push for agentic work
item.dc:creator: Ivan Mehta
item.description: The notetaker offers a generous free plan, and that has resulted in over 400,000 monthly active users. The company said that over 1 million people have recorded meetings until now.
